design.motif: A vintage desk-telephone switchboard surface: matte phenolic micrograin, gently curved paired cable-routing grooves and a few recessed connector-channel ends. Lines converge loosely toward an open gap without a reset loop. No phone object, dial, digits, text or glowing indicators.

description.en: Matte phenolic micrograin, gently curved paired cable-routing grooves and a few recessed connector-channel ends.
description.zh: 哑光酚醛表面的双线槽与凹入接口边缘，让对话的接入和转接有了旧式交换台的触感。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: A local-first Mac gateway that brings AI agents to Discord, the terminal, and HTTP.
description.zh: 优先在本地运行的 Mac AI 智能体网关，连接 Discord、终端与 HTTP。

purpose.en: Use a locally hosted personal agent through Discord, a terminal, or HTTP to work with files, commands, remembered context, and scheduled tasks.
purpose.zh: 通过 Discord、终端或 HTTP 使用本机运行的个人 Agent，处理文件、命令、已有记忆和定时任务。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
